mentions.name: Triplox
mentions.description: Triplox is a Datalog engine built on top of object storage, using SlateDB at the storage layer and inspired by Datomic. Its goal is for object storage to be the only source of truth and primitive in its final version. It features experimental incremental queries that provide the full power of Datalog with incremental query support, on which views or streaming solutions can be built, and it experiments with worst-case optimal joins in the standard engine.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on a Datalog engine on top of object storage. The system is called https://triplox.xyz/. I am using SlateDB at the storage layer. The system is very much inspired by Datomic.
